title: Bounded Stiffness-Aware Embedded Richards Temporal Indicator Feasibility
problem_statement: Determine whether the F-SI23 derivative-difference observer can be converted into a bounded-cost, stiffness-aware model-owned temporal indicator without deep same-endpoint refinement, without raw step-doubling/retry translation, and without changing the mass-conservative backward-Euler principal state.

hard_scope.allowed_test_only_reference_work: Existing F-SI21/F-SI22/F-SI23/F-VQ evidence may be reused; new deep reference ladders are not a Gate-A requirement.

candidate_families_for_gate_A.construction: Use F-SI23 e_h directly with no stiffness correction.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.expected_cost: O(N) arithmetic after one accepted/trial BE solve.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.known_positive_evidence: Exact eigenmode relation and nonlinear C2 finite-comparator consistency.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.known_blocker: Raw magnitude is extremely and strongly state dependent; no scientific tolerance or mixed-form true-error bound is qualified.

candidate_families_for_gate_A.construction: Infer a scalar effective stiffness from derivative evolution, e.g. a source-bound dimensionless ratio such as hdot_n/hdot_np1 where mathematically admissible, and analytically map the raw e_h magnitude through a linear backward-Euler model.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.expected_cost: O(N) arithmetic; no extra nonlinear solve.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.known_positive_evidence: F-SI23 C3 late-level scalar behavior became closer to the linear eigenmode expectation as dt decreased.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.known_blocker: Early/large-dt scalar predictions were poor, modes are spatially distributed, derivative components may cross zero, and no universal scalar correction is qualified.

candidate_families_for_gate_A.construction: Reconstruct a Jacobian/operator at the accepted candidate state and use one additional O(N) tridiagonal linear action/solve to transport or damp the leading derivative-difference error vector, while leaving the principal BE state unchanged.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.expected_cost: One final-state coefficient/Jacobian reconstruction plus at most one tridiagonal linear solve; no extra full nonlinear Richards trajectory.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.known_positive_evidence: Reference workspace already owns tridiagonal Jacobian scratch and the linear solver is O(N); literature supports derivative-based adaptive control and single-correction implicit constructions as a bounded-cost direction.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.known_blocker: The Jacobian left by current HeadCalc is built on pre-update old_head, not exactly on the accepted final state, so direct reuse of existing dfdh arrays is not source-bound.

candidate_families_for_gate_A.construction: Use the dfdh arrays already left in worker scratch without rebuilding at the accepted state.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.reason: Source reading shows the matrix is assembled at old_head before the accepted Newton update and is not rebuilt after convergence.

candidate_families_for_gate_A.construction: Use extra full nonlinear trajectories as normal temporal estimator.
candidate_families_for_gate_A.reason: Conflicts with F-SI21 cost gate, F-VQ28 runtime-translation evidence, F-SI23 C3 comparator availability and SWAP invariants on bounded coupling cost/predictable compute.

gate_A_questions: What exact Jacobian/operator does HeadCalc expose after a converged solve, and at which iterate/state was it assembled?
Can a mathematically defined final-state tridiagonal operator be reconstructed from accepted candidate state plus existing parameter/provider information in O(N) without modifying physical state?
For the exact F-SI23 C1B eigenmode, what correction should each candidate family produce and does it recover the known analytic behavior?
Can any retained candidate be defined componentwise/vectorially without unsafe division by near-zero derivatives or a single dominant-mode assumption?
Does the candidate remain separate from the hard mass ledger and leave the accepted mixed-form backward-Euler state unchanged?
Can the candidate be computed transactionally from worker scratch and optional numerical history, with no update on rejected trial/rollback?
Is normal-path cost bounded to O(N) extra work and at most one tridiagonal linear solve, with zero extra full nonlinear Richards solves?
gate_A_pass_condition: At least one candidate must have a complete source-bound construction, an exact analytic interpretation on the manufactured linear eigenmode, no contradiction with F-VQ28 retry evidence, hard separation from mass acceptance, and bounded normal-path cost without relying on the stale pre-update Jacobian as if it were final-state exact.
gate_A_fail_condition: If no candidate satisfies these conditions, close F-SI24 fail-closed rather than introduce an empirical scale/tolerance or an extra nonlinear refinement path.

candidate_progression_if_gate_A_passes.Gate_B: test-only exact/manufactured operator qualification, including vector/multimode cases and singular/near-zero derivative safeguards
candidate_progression_if_gate_A_passes.Gate_C: nonlinear B1.10 characterization against existing independent finite same-endpoint evidence; calibration and held-out matrices must be separated before execution
candidate_progression_if_gate_A_passes.F_KT: only after a concrete transaction lifecycle and unavailable-estimator semantics exist
candidate_progression_if_gate_A_passes.F_VQ: independent held-out qualification only after a specific owner candidate exists

invariant_focus.5_scratch_per_worker: Estimator Jacobian/resolvent scratch belongs to worker/job, not persistent column state.
invariant_focus.7_transactional_timesteps: No numerical history or certificate state changes before commit; rollback restores committed estimator history.
invariant_focus.8_cheap_recompute_warm_start: Estimator must not require a deep trajectory per retry.
invariant_focus.9_generic_time: All formulas use generic dt, no day/calendar assumption.
invariant_focus.13_mass_conservation: Mass ledger remains independent and hard; indicator may never compensate or excuse imbalance.
invariant_focus.15_limit_coupling_cost: Normal path has no extra full nonlinear Richards run and at most one O(N) linear companion action.
invariant_focus.23_physics_solver_policy_separation: Temporal indicator is numerical policy/evidence only; physics stays unchanged.
invariant_focus.24_predictable_compute: Estimator work must be bounded and must fail closed if required operator/history is unavailable.
invariant_focus.25_reference_mode: Full reference mode remains available and is not replaced by the estimator.
invariant_focus.26_diagnostics: Availability, correction route, raw/corrected magnitudes and fallback/rejection reason must be diagnosable if later implemented.

next_action: Complete Gate A source mapping of accepted-state versus stored-Jacobian semantics and derive exact manufactured-eigenmode behavior for candidate families B and C before implementing any F-SI24 test harness or production seam.
